停车操作时远离加油站等危险区域，避免在易燃环境中发射。: When operating parked, keep away from hazardous areas such as fuel stations and do not transmit in flammable environments.
发动机点火系统产生的脉冲干扰，需滤波与屏蔽抑制。: Impulse interference from the engine's ignition system, suppressed by filtering and shielding.
呼号后缀 /M 表示陆地移动操作，/MM 表示海上移动。: The suffix /M indicates land-mobile operation and /M/M maritime mobile.
天线座与车身金属可靠连接，必要时加装接地编织带。: Bond the antenna mount reliably to bare bodywork metal, adding grounding braid if needed.
天线系统与车身良好搭铁，改善辐射并降低噪声。: Bond the antenna system well to the vehicle body; it improves radiation and lowers noise.
安装在车辆上的 VHF/UHF 收发信机，功率通常 25–50W。: A VHF/UHF transceiver installed in a vehicle, usually 25–50 W.
正负极均接电瓶，串接合适保险丝，线径足够粗以减小压降。: Connect both poles to the battery, with a suitable fuse in series and cable thick enough to limit voltage drop.
点火系统加滤波，馈线绕磁环抑制屏蔽层共模电流。: Filter the ignition system and wind the feedline on a toroid to suppress common-mode current on the shield.
电源线直接接电瓶，避免点烟器限流与共模噪声。: Run the supply leads straight to the battery, avoiding the current limit of the cigarette-lighter socket and common-mode noise.
磁吸或夹边固定，尽量装在车顶中央，用车身作地网。: Magnetic-mount or lip-mount; place it as close to the centre of the roof as possible, using the bodywork as a ground plane.
移动中信号受多径与遮挡影响出现起伏，属正常现象。: While moving, signals fluctuate due to multipath and shadowing — that is normal.
行驶中操作电台须遵守当地法规，优先保证驾驶安全。: Operating while driving must comply with local regulations; driving safety comes first.
